  • Experience in automation testing using any tools such as Appium, Selenium, RestAssured, Playwright, etc.
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills
  • Working knowledge of web services, databases, and web technologies
  • Analytical & flexible in working style and mindset
  • Basic knowledge about SQL
  • Experience working with JIRA
  • Self-organized and has an eye for details
  • Internally motivated, able to work proficiently both independently and in a team environment
  • Well versed in oral and written communication

  • Basic understanding of testing AI-powered features, including concepts such as hallucination, accuracy, relevance, robustness, and prompt-related risks.

descriptionFromApi:
Backend Lead Key Responsibilities
  • Own the backend of the platform end to end - the clinical record, orders, laboratory and radiology, billing and insurance, pharmacy and stock, and the services that hold them together
  • Set the service and data design for these modules, and review every change that touches a clinical record, a price, a ledger or a claim
  • Lead the backend engineers: set the standard, review their work in progress rather than only at the end, and keep the codebase something a new engineer can be productive in within a fortnight
  • Turn what a hospital actually does into a model the software can hold, working from real documents - a tariff sheet, a rate contract, a scheme circular - which will be inconsistent, hand-maintained and full of exceptions
  • Own the Application Programming Interface (API) contracts the web and mobile applications consume, and keep them stable enough to be relied on
Correctness You Can Prove
  • Make every write auditable and attributable: who did it, when, and what it replaced - corrections by reversal, never by silent overwrite
  • Hold the line on money and stock, where a rounding error is a real rupee in a real hospitals accounts and a stock count that drifts is medicine that cannot be found - Decimal for every amount, never a float
  • Make clinical safety checks real: allergy and interaction checks, dose limits by age and weight, critical values that must reach a human, and alerts a doctor cannot silently lose
  • Build multi-tenancy in from the first table - one platform serving many hospitals, with no path by which one can see anothers data
  • Own the reconciliation story: what the cashier counted, what the system says and what the day-end report shows must agree, and any difference must be explainable
Interoperability and Standards
  • Own the interoperability strategy: Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) R4 as the fa ade the outside world reads and writes, over an internal model designed for how hospitals actually run
  • Deliver Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) compliance - Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) creation and linking, consent, and health information exchange
  • Make sure the platform speaks to the equipment that already exists in the hospital: Health Level Seven (HL7) version 2 messages from laboratory analysers, and Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine (DICOM) worklists for imaging
  • Use standard terminologies where they earn their place - Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes (LOINC), Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms (SNOMED CT), International Classification of Diseases (ICD-10) - and map to them rather than making clinicians work in them
  • Treat integration failure as normal: retries, dead letters, replay, and a system that keeps working when the hospitals internet does not
Delivery Oversight
  • Keep the backlog for the backend sequenced and estimated honestly, and flag slippage the week it becomes likely
  • Review pull requests with an eye on the data as much as the code - a migration that silently rounds is worse than a bug that crashes
  • Own the automated tests around money, stock and clinical safety; these are the paths where tests are mandatory rather than encouraged
  • Own the operational side too: what happens at three in the morning when something fails, and how anyone finds out
Key Skills and Technical Knowledge Our stack - what you will work in day to day
  • Language - Python 3.12 with type hints everywhere, and Structured Query Language (SQL)
  • Framework - FastAPI, with Pydantic v2 for validation and serialisation
  • Database access - SQLAlchemy 2.0 in async mode, with Alembic for migrations
  • Typing, enforced - mypy or Pyright in strict mode, failing the build. Pythons type hints are optional at runtime, so we make them non-optional in continuous integration
  • Database - PostgreSQL 16, with migrations, indexes and query plans. Managed Postgres on whichever cloud a hospital requires: Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) or Aurora, Google Cloud SQL or AlloyDB, or Azure Database for PostgreSQL
  • Caching - Redis (Amazon ElastiCache, Google Memorystore or Azure Cache for Redis)
  • Background work and events - a task queue with idempotent consumers, dead-letter handling and replay: Celery, Dramatiq, arq or a PostgreSQL-backed queue, on a broker we can run ourselves rather than one that ties us to a single cloud
  • Object storage - behind one interface, with a driver per provider: Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3), Google Cloud Storage or Azure Blob Storage
  • Containers and cloud - Docker everywhere, which is what makes the platform portable across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Microsoft Azure: Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS) Fargate, Google Cloud Run, Azure Container Apps, or Kubernetes where a customer requires it
  • Infrastructure as code - Terraform, with a module per cloud and one pipeline
  • Delivery - GitHub Actions, trunk-based development, migrations only through version control
  • Testing - pytest and pytest-asyncio, and Playwright for Application Programming Interface (API) and end-to-end journeys
  • API contract - FastAPI generates the OpenAPI schema, and the TypeScript client the web and mobile applications use is generated from it, so the contract cannot quietly drift
  • Healthcare standards - Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) R4, Health Level Seven (HL7) version 2 over Minimal Lower Layer Protocol (MLLP), Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes (LOINC), Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms (SNOMED CT), International Classification of Diseases (ICD-10), Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine (DICOM), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) and Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA)
Valuable to have as well
  • The Python healthcare libraries: fhir.resources for FHIR R4 models, hl7apy or python-hl7 for version 2 messaging, pydicom for imaging
  • Machine learning and Artificial Intelligence (AI) work in Python - the AI services share this language, which is one of the reasons we chose it
  • Experience writing code that runs on more than one cloud, and a view on where an abstraction is worth it and where it is not
  • Open-source FHIR servers such as HAPI FHIR or Medplum
  • Indian Goods and Services Tax (GST), Third Party Administrator (TPA) and insurance claims, or Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PMJAY)
  • On-premise or hybrid deployment inside a hospitals own network
  • Multi-tenant Software as a Service (SaaS) architecture, and data residency across countries
If your background is Java, .NET, Node or Go
  • We build in Python on FastAPI, and that is what you would write here
  • If you come from Django or Flask, FastAPI will feel immediately familiar - the difference is async, Pydantic and generated OpenAPI documentation
  • Java, Spring Boot, Kotlin, C#, .NET, Go, Scala, Ruby on Rails or Node.js and TypeScript with strong service, API and relational database experience transfers directly. What does not transfer is loose typing habits and an aversion to SQL
  • We expect you productive in Python within the first month, and we will give you that month
What Youll Bring
  • Six or more years building backend services in production, with at least two setting direction for other engineers
  • Strong Python, used with type hints and tested - or another typed backend language with the willingness to work in Python from day one
  • Deep relational database skill: schema design, transactions and isolation levels, indexes, and the ability to read a query plan and act on it
  • Have owned a system where correctness is auditable after the fact - healthcare, billing, payments, accounting, insurance, lending or similar
  • Have modelled a domain that resisted simple modelling, and can explain the trade-offs you took and the ones you regret
  • Comfortable with event-driven work: queues, at-least-once delivery, idempotency, ordering and replay
  • Able to design an API another team consumes, and hold its contract stable
  • Able to explain a technical constraint to a hospital accountant, and a hospitals billing rule to an engineer who has never seen a hospital bill
  • Willing to sit at a billing counter or beside a doctor for a day and come back with the questions the specification missed
  • Preferred experience with healthcare interoperability - FHIR, HL7 version 2, LOINC, SNOMED CT, ABDM or another national health data exchange
  • Preferred experience with Indian Goods and Services Tax (GST), insurance and Third Party Administrator (TPA) claims, pharmacy or retail inventory with batch and expiry, or a system migrated off a legacy database

Job Description

Rockwell is seeking a Power BI-focused BI Analyst to join an agile team responsible for delivering scalable, enterprise-grade analytics solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Power BI, data analytics, and SQL-based data sources, along with the ability to translate business requirements into actionable insights.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent.
  • Strong experience in Power BI development, including DAX, Power Query, and data modeling
  • Solid understanding of SQL, relational databases, and dimensional modeling (star schema)
  • Experience working with enterprise data sources (Azure SQL, SQL Server, SharePoint, etc.)
  • Strong understanding of business KPIs (operations, finance, performance metrics)
  • Ability to translate business requirements into analytical solutions and actionable insights
  • Strong communication skills to present insights clearly to business stakeholders
  • Experience working in data governance-aligned environments


Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and semantic data models for enterprise use
  • Gather and translate business requirements into scalable and impactful BI solutions
  • Apply best practices in dimensional modeling (star schema) and semantic model design
  • Build and optimize data models using Power Query, DAX, and relational data principles
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and validation across all reports and datasets
  • Optimize dataset performance (model size, refresh efficiency, query performance)
  • Align reporting outputs with standardized KPI definitions and business frameworks
  • Develop and maintain reusable datasets and governed data models
  • Identify and resolve data quality issues in collaboration with data owners
  • Perform trend analysis and exploratory analytics to identify insights and business performance drivers
  • Design intuitive, user-friendly dashboards to enable self-service BI adoption
  • Communicate insights, assumptions, and data limitations clearly to stakeholders
  • Integrate Power BI with multiple data sources (Azure SQL, SharePoint, APIs, etc.)
  • Maintain documentation for datasets, calculations, and data lineage
  • Collaborate with global teams and follow Agile delivery practices

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on expertise in Power BI (DAX, Power Query, data modeling, visualization best practices)
  • Experience in optimizing large-scale or enterprise Power BI datasets and reports
  • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ETL processes, and data pipeline design
  • Familiarity with data governance, data lineage, and reporting standards
  • Exposure to advanced analytics (trend analysis, forecasting, AI-ready datasets)
  • Experience integrating Power BI with APIs, cloud platforms, or multiple enterprise systems
  • Familiarity with Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) - secondary skill
  • Experience with Dataverse or cloud-based data platforms
  • Microsoft Certification: Power BI Data Analyst (PL-300) or equivalent

jobDescription:
Job Summary

React Frontend Development (Primary Focus)

Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain complex React applications dashboards, analytics platforms, internal tools, and customer-facing products
  • Develop responsive, mobile-first UIs optimized for tablet (iPad) and desktop with pixel-perfect execution
  • Build rich data visualizations using D3.js, Recharts, Chart.js, or custom SVG/Canvas components
  • Implement advanced state management patterns using Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query, or Context API
  • Create reusable, well-documented component libraries with design system integration (Tailwind CSS, Styled Components, or CSS Modules)
  • Optimize frontend performance: code splitting, lazy loading, memoisation, virtual scrolling, bundle analysis
  • Write comprehensive tests using Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress for E2E testing
  • Implement real-time features using WebSockets, Server-Sent Events, or polling strategies

API Design Backend Development

  • Design and build RESTful APIs using Node.js (Express/Fastify) or Python (FastAPI/Flask) following OpenAPI specifications
  • Develop GraphQL APIs where appropriate for complex data querying needs
  • Implement authentication and authorization (OAuth 2.0, JWT, RBAC) for secure API access
  • Build middleware for logging, rate limiting, caching, error handling, and request validation
  • Design database schemas and write efficient queries (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar)
  • Implement API versioning, pagination, filtering, and search capabilities
  • Build and maintain microservices or serverless functions (Azure Functions / AWS Lambda)
  • Create API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI and maintain developer-facing docs

Integration Data Layer

  • Integrate frontend applications with data platforms (Databricks, data warehouses, data lakes) through API layers
  • Build data ingestion endpoints that accept, validate, transform, and store incoming data
  • Work with data engineers to consume curated datasets and serve them through optimized APIs
  • Implement caching strategies (Redis, CDN, browser cache) for high-performance data delivery
  • Connect to third-party services and APIs (payment gateways, CRM, loyalty platforms, analytics tools)

AI / LLM Integration

  • Build conversational AI interfaces (chatbots, knowledge agents) using LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI)
  • Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns for document QA and contextual search
  • Create prompt engineering frameworks and manage AI response streaming in React UIs

DevOps Delivery

  • Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI)
  • Containerize applications with Docker and deploy to Kubernetes or cloud-managed services
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability (Datadog, New Relic, or Application Insights)
  • Conduct code reviews, mentor junior developers, and drive engineering best practices

Requirements

Must have skills

  • 57 years of professional full stack development experience in a product engineering environment
  • Expert-level React.js (4+ years): hooks, context, suspense, server components, performance patterns
  • Strong TypeScript proficiency type-safe component development, generics, utility types
  • Production experience building and consuming REST APIs (Node.js with Express/Fastify or Python with FastAPI)
  • Solid database skills: PostgreSQL or MySQL (schema design, indexing, query optimization) and/or MongoDB
  • Experience with modern CSS: Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, or Styled Components for scalable styling
  • Proficiency with Git, branching strategies, PR workflows, and collaborative development
  • Experience with cloud platforms: Azure (preferred) or AWS app hosting, serverless, storage, CDN
  • Strong understanding of web security: CORS, XSS, CSRF, CSP, authentication flows
  • Experience with Docker containerization and basic Kubernetes or cloud-managed container services
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and working in cross-functional, distributed teams

Good to have skills

  • Experience with Next.js (App Router, SSR, ISR, API routes) or Remix
  • GraphQL development experience (Apollo Server/Client or similar)
  • Data visualization expertise: D3.js, Recharts, Plotly, custom charting
  • Experience integrating with LLM/AI APIs and building AI-powered features
  • Knowledge of Databricks, Apache Spark, or data lake/warehouse concepts
  • Experience with real-time systems: WebSockets, Kafka consumers, event-driven architecture
  • Familiarity with design tools (Figma) and design-to-code workflows
  • Understanding of retail / e-commerce domain (POS, loyalty, customer analytics)
  • Experience with Storybook for component documentation and visual testing
  • Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and internationalization (i18n)

Education

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • Relevant certifications are a plus: AWS/Azure Developer, Meta React Certification, or similar

React Frontend Development (Primary Focus)

Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain complex React applications dashboards, analytics platforms, internal tools, and customer-facing products
  • Develop responsive, mobile-first UIs optimized for tablet (iPad) and desktop with pixel-perfect execution
  • Build rich data visualizations using D3.js, Recharts, Chart.js, or custom SVG/Canvas components
  • Implement advanced state management patterns using Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query, or Context API
  • Create reusable, well-documented component libraries with design system integration (Tailwind CSS, Styled Components, or CSS Modules)
  • Optimize frontend performance: code splitting, lazy loading, memoisation, virtual scrolling, bundle analysis
  • Write comprehensive tests using Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress for E2E testing
  • Implement real-time features using WebSockets, Server-Sent Events, or polling strategies

API Design Backend Development

  • Design and build RESTful APIs using Node.js (Express/Fastify) or Python (FastAPI/Flask) following OpenAPI specifications
  • Develop GraphQL APIs where appropriate for complex data querying needs
  • Implement authentication and authorization (OAuth 2.0, JWT, RBAC) for secure API access
  • Build middleware for logging, rate limiting, caching, error handling, and request validation
  • Design database schemas and write efficient queries (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar)
  • Implement API versioning, pagination, filtering, and search capabilities
  • Build and maintain microservices or serverless functions (Azure Functions / AWS Lambda)
  • Create API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI and maintain developer-facing docs

Integration Data Layer

  • Integrate frontend applications with data platforms (Databricks, data warehouses, data lakes) through API layers
  • Build data ingestion endpoints that accept, validate, transform, and store incoming data
  • Work with data engineers to consume curated datasets and serve them through optimized APIs
  • Implement caching strategies (Redis, CDN, browser cache) for high-performance data delivery
  • Connect to third-party services and APIs (payment gateways, CRM, loyalty platforms, analytics tools)

AI / LLM Integration

  • Build conversational AI interfaces (chatbots, knowledge agents) using LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI)
  • Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns for document QA and contextual search
  • Create prompt engineering frameworks and manage AI response streaming in React UIs

DevOps Delivery

  • Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI)
  • Containerize applications with Docker and deploy to Kubernetes or cloud-managed services
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability (Datadog, New Relic, or Application Insights)
  • Conduct code reviews, mentor junior developers, and drive engineering best practices

Requirements

Must have skills

  • 57 years of professional full stack development experience in a product engineering environment
  • Expert-level React.js (4+ years): hooks, context, suspense, server components, performance patterns
  • Strong TypeScript proficiency type-safe component development, generics, utility types
  • Production experience building and consuming REST APIs (Node.js with Express/Fastify or Python with FastAPI)
  • Solid database skills: PostgreSQL or MySQL (schema design, indexing, query optimization) and/or MongoDB
  • Experience with modern CSS: Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, or Styled Components for scalable styling
  • Proficiency with Git, branching strategies, PR workflows, and collaborative development
  • Experience with cloud platforms: Azure (preferred) or AWS app hosting, serverless, storage, CDN
  • Strong understanding of web security: CORS, XSS, CSRF, CSP, authentication flows
  • Experience with Docker containerization and basic Kubernetes or cloud-managed container services
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and working in cross-functional, distributed teams

Good to have skills

  • Experience with Next.js (App Router, SSR, ISR, API routes) or Remix
  • GraphQL development experience (Apollo Server/Client or similar)
  • Data visualization expertise: D3.js, Recharts, Plotly, custom charting
  • Experience integrating with LLM/AI APIs and building AI-powered features
  • Knowledge of Databricks, Apache Spark, or data lake/warehouse concepts
  • Experience with real-time systems: WebSockets, Kafka consumers, event-driven architecture
  • Familiarity with design tools (Figma) and design-to-code workflows
  • Understanding of retail / e-commerce domain (POS, loyalty, customer analytics)
  • Experience with Storybook for component documentation and visual testing
  • Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and internationalization (i18n)

Education

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • Relevant certifications are a plus: AWS/Azure Developer, Meta React Certification, or similar

jobDescription:
Location Manesar
Region Supported APAC
Shift Morning Shift / APAC-aligned business hours
Language Thai/Korean
Role Summary
The Sales Process Specialist will support APAC Sales teams by managing key sales support activities, improving process efficiency, and ensuring timely and accurate execution of operational tasks. The role will focus on enabling Sales productivity by simplifying processes, maintaining data quality, coordinating with cross-functional teams, and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement across sales operations workflows.
Key Responsibilities
  • Support APAC Sales teams with day-to-day sales process activities, ensuring timely and accurate completion of assigned tasks.
  • Assist with Quote-to-Cash related activities, including quote support, order coordination, contract documentation, customer account updates, and request follow-ups.
  • Maintain accurate and high-quality data in Salesforce CRM, SAP, CPQ, and related business systems.
  • Drive efficiency by identifying process gaps, reducing manual effort, and recommending opportunities for process simplification and improvement using AI.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Customer Service, Finance, Logistics, and other cross-functional teams to resolve operational issues and improve turnaround time.
  • Track task status, follow up on pending items, and support SLA adherence for sales support activities.
  • Prepare basic reports, dashboards, and process updates to support visibility and decision-making.
  • Support regional projects, process transitions, system enhancements, and digital transformation initiatives.
Core Skill Sets
  • Strong understanding of sales support operations and Quote-to-Cash processes, with the ability to support APAC Sales teams through timely, accurate, and customer-focused execution.
  • Process simplification and continuous improvement mindset, including the ability to identify gaps, reduce manual effort, improve workflows, and drive operational efficiency.
  • Digital, data, and AI readiness, with working knowledge of tools such as Salesforce, SAP, CPQ, Excel, Power BI, and the ability to validate AI-enabled outputs responsibly.
  • Critical thinking, stakeholder communication, ownership, and learning agility to manage unclear requests, prioritize effectively, keep Sales teams informed, and adapt quickly across APAC processes.
Preferred Skills
Candidates with experience or knowledge in the following areas will be preferred:
  • Salesforce CRM, CPQ, and SAP ECC
  • Sales support operations and Quote-to-Cash processes
  • Power BI, Excel reporting, or basic data analytics
  • Process mapping, process documentation, and workflow optimization
  • Business process automation and digital productivity tools
  • Continuous improvement or Lean mindset
  • Data quality, governance, and operational compliance
  • Customer experience and stakeholder service improvement
Key Competencies
  • Sales and customer focus
  • Process excellence and simplification mindset
  • Data accuracy and attention to detail
  • Collaboration and stakeholder management
  • Ownership and accountability
  • Continuous improvement mindset
  • Adaptability and learning agility
  • Problem solving and prioritization
Qualifications Required Qualifications
  • Bachelors degree in Business, Commerce, Operations, or a related field.
  • 2-3 years of experience in Sales Operations, Sales Support, Commercial Operations, Customer Support, or Business Process Management.
  • Demonstrated exposure to process simplification, process improvement, or operational efficiency initiatives.
  • Experience working with ERP systems; Salesforce, SAP, or CPQ experience will be an advantage.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work across APAC teams.
  • Good analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
Additional Details
This job has a full time weekly schedule.
Travel Required: No
Shift: Day
Duration: No End Date
Job Function: Administration

title: Workday Solutions Manager
jobDescription:
Job Summary

The Workday Solutions Manager leads the execution, development, and innovation of Workday across the enterprise. This role combines strategic leadership and hands-on technical expertise, ensuring Workday remains the organization s single source of truth for Human Capital, Finance, and Operations. The incumbent manages the Workday COE team, oversees integration lifecycle management, and drives automation, AI enablement, and orchestration initiatives to optimize business operations aligned to the company s vision and organizational objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Work with Senior Management to align Workday solutions to overall business goals
  • Ensure the productivity and technical excellence of the HRIS team to meet organizational goals.
  • Serve as the technical execution lead for Workday SKUs, integrations, Orchestrations, applications, and Agents.
  • Collaborate with Human Capital, Finance, and Technology and Innovation to design scalable Workday solutions aligned with business strategy.
  • Oversee the development, deployment, and maintenance of integrations using applicable applications
  • Manage and optimize Workday applications to automate and enhance workflows.
  • Implement and maintain Workday Orchestrations and Agents to improve process efficiency and automation.
  • Lead readiness, regression testing, and deployment of new Workday releases SKUs and features.
  • Ensure strong data governance, security, and compliance within Workday environments.
  • Mentor and develop WD COE Team to strengthen Workday technical capabilities within the team and SME s within the organisation
  • Engage with Workday early adopter and partner programs to evaluate new technologies and functionalities.
  • Collaborate with PMO on project intake, prioritization, and execution of cross-functional initiatives.
  • Attend relevant conferences annually for professional and technical advancement.
  • Champion the organization s core values and promote collaboration and innovation across teams.
  • Other duties as assigned.

By applying to this position, you acknowledge that you have read and understood Bill Gosling Outsourcing s privacy policy and consent to the collection, use, and storage of personal information in accordance with the policy.

jobDescription:
About Maersk

Maersk is building the next generation of digital capabilities for the global supply chain.

We are re-architecting our platform with a data-first approach - building a trusted, scalable and reusable data foundation for current and future supply-chain use cases.

On top of this foundation, we will build ML models, intelligence, recommendations, GenAI and agentic AI to help customers and teams make better and faster decisions.

About Darwinbox
Darwinbox is Asia's fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1200+ global enterprises to manage their 4.5million+ employees across 130+ countries. Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: DP World, JG Summit, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more.
Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
Why Join Us
The way Darwinbox is evolving is unlike anything we have seen before. AI is transforming our platform, our customer experience, and the future of HR technology; this role will be at the forefront of turning that vision into reality. You will help bring our AI ambition to life in the field, working on high-impact problems with strategic customers while shaping how Darwinbox scales its next generation of intelligent products. This is the founding cohort of an entirely new function at Darwinbox the first FDEs will shape how the team operates, which customer engagements get the embedded model first, and how it scales. You will work zero layers removed from the customer and touch a stack broader than any pure product engineering role allows: the Darwinbox platform, Python at production scale, the LLM stack of your choice (Claude, GPT, Gemini), MCP servers, agent frameworks, and whatever the customer happens to run on their side.
Youll experience a culture of:
  • Disproportionate Rewards for top performance
  • Accelerated Growth in a hyper-growth environment
  • Continuous Learning and Professional Development
  • Meaningful Relationships and a Collaborative Environment
About the role
The Forward Deployed Engineer embeds with Darwinbox's most strategic enterprise customers to ship production-grade AI agents and Agentic Flows on the Darwinbox HCM platform inside each customer's environment. The role centres on three skill areas: production Python engineering for AI agents, deployment of LLM applications (prompt engineering at scale, RAG, agent orchestration, evaluation frameworks), and architecting REST API and webhook integrations with payroll, ATS, SSO/IDP, learning, and ERP systems. You will work hands-on inside customer environments on HR workflow problems that exceed the platform's standard configuration surfaces.
What you will do
  • Embed with 23 strategic enterprise customers in parallel as the technical owner of the Darwinbox deployment in their environment.
  • Run discovery with CHROs, HRBPs, and HRIS leads to surface the real problem behind the stated ask and translate it into a working technical design.
  • Deliver a working prototype within ~1 week of engagement kick-off, codify repeatable deployment patterns, and channel field insights into the Darwinbox platform roadmap.
  • Design and ship production-grade AI agents on the Darwinbox platform for HR workflows including leave, performance, attendance, onboarding/exit automation, and HR decision support.
  • Architect custom integrations between Darwinbox and customer-side payroll, ATS, SSO/IDP, learning platforms, and ERP stacks using REST APIs, webhooks, and event-driven patterns.
  • Travel 2540 percent of the time to customer sites across India, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East as required.
What we are looking for
Required
  • Hands-on production Python engineering for enterprise SaaS, integrations, and AI agent development.
  • Production deployment of LLM applications: prompt engineering at scale, RAG pipelines, agent orchestration, and evaluation frameworks.
  • REST API and webhook integration design for systems interoperability (payroll, ATS, SSO/IDP, learning, ERP) with production-grade auth.
  • Customer discovery and technical translation with senior enterprise stakeholders (CHROs, HRBPs, HRIS leads).
  • Production LLM experience and willingness to travel 2540 percent candidates with only academic/demo AI exposure or hard travel constraints are unlikely to be the right fit.
Preferred
  • HCM domain knowledge across payroll, performance, attendance, talent, and recruitment workflows.
  • MCP server implementation or agent framework experience (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) and AI observability tools (LangSmith, Langfuse).
  • TypeScript or Java in addition to Python; multilingual capability across Hindi, English, or additional Indian / SEA languages.
  • Former technical founder experience, or experience in enterprise SaaS environments such as Salesforce (Agentforce), Atlassian, Databricks, Uniphore, UnifyApps, Sprinklr, Freshworks, Zoho, or similar settings with hands- on AI deployment work.
Experience and qualifications
  • 14 years of professional software engineering experience, including customer-facing (Hard requirement).
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related quantitative discipline; no certifications required.

Ethical & Secure AI Focus: Strong understanding of data compliance, enterprise privacy constraints, and mitigating AI risks (hallucinations, bias, data leakage).

Experience: 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 2 years dedicated to building, deploying, or integrating AI/ML and NLP systems. Prior experience in technical consulting or enterprise deployment is a major plus.
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Information technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent practical technical experience.

The hard part is genuinely hard. Multi-tenant isolation where a leak is an incident, not a bug. Software that has to install and run correctly in an environment we cannot SSH into. Cost and performance that a customer’s CFO reads every month. Big surface area. Backend most weeks, but you’ll touch frontend, infra and data whenever the problem needs it. Nobody here is the API person. Fast decisions. No design committee, no six-approver RFC. Make the argument well and we do it — often the same day. What you’ll actually do? Own a product area end to end — design it, build it, ship it, and carry the pager for it. Ship to production every week. Watch the dashboards. Fix what you learn. Join customer and design-partner calls. You’ll hear the problem first-hand instead of through three layers of translation. Make real calls: what we build, what we adopt off the shelf, what we delete. Get us into environments most vendors can’t reach — install, run and debug where you can’t just tail the logs. Review other people’s code seriously, and take reviews the same way. What you’ll work with: The real stack, not an aspirational one: Backend: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, pgvector Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js Infra: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, AWS. Air-gapped installs are a first-class target, which makes packaging a real problem rather than an afterthought Platform: Temporal for durable work, Keycloak for enterprise SSO, Prometheus and Grafana for knowing what’s happening at 3am AI: LLMs daily, but this is a systems and product job, not a research one. If you want to train models, we’re the wrong shop. If you want to make them cheap, observable and reliable inside a bank, we’re a very good one On Kubernetes: this one isn’t optional. We ship into customers’ clusters, so you need to have genuinely run workloads on K8s in production — not did the tutorial, not our platform team handled it. Come with the war story: what broke, how you found it, what you changed. The rest is flexible. We’ve hired strong people from Go, Java and Rust who were productive inside a month; the language matters far less than the judgment. What are we looking for? Must have: 3+ years shipping software people actually used. Side projects and open source count. Strong in at least one modern backend language, and unafraid of the frontend or the infra when the problem needs it. We hire for judgment, not a keyword list. Real Kubernetes experience — you’ve deployed, debugged and operated workloads on it in production. This is the one hard requirement. You’ve owned something in production. You know what 2am feels like. Solid with a relational database — schema design, and why the query is slow. You can write. A clear PR description and clear thinking are the same skill. You debug from evidence, not vibes. Nice to have: Multi-tenant SaaS, security, or infrastructure-heavy products. Helm and Terraform alongside the Kubernetes — especially shipping software into someone else’s environment. Anything AI/LLM adjacent — genuinely useful, and genuinely not required. Strong engineers pick this up in weeks. You’ve been early somewhere before and know what that actually costs. You’ll love it here if? You’d rather ship something imperfect on Friday than something perfect next quarter. Ambiguity gets you moving instead of stalling you. You have strong opinions and hold them loosely. That’s not my job isn’t in your vocabulary.

Job Summary
Project description We are seeking a Senior Semantic Engineer to implement semantic data frameworks that provide a shared structure for enterprise data. In this role you will focus on building and maintaining ontologies and knowledge graphs, enforcing semantic validation rules for data quality, and collaborating with AI teams to integrate these semantic structures into intelligent applications. The position is industry-agnostic, emphasizing strong semantic web expertise and the ability to apply it in any enterprise context.
Responsibilities
  • Ontology Design Maintenance: Design, develop, and maintain ontologies (using OWL/RDF or similar) that model key enterprise data domains and relationships, ensuring a consistent and shared data vocabulary across the organization. This includes collaborating with domain experts to capture real-world concepts and validate that the ontology accurately represents business knowledge.
  • Knowledge Graph Development: Build and manage enterprise knowledge graphs based on the defined ontologies, linking diverse data sources into a unified graph data model. This involves configuring graph databases or triple stores, populating the knowledge graph with data (RDF triples), and optimizing it for query performance and scalability.
  • Semantic Querying (SPARQL): Create and optimize SPARQL queries to enable efficient retrieval, integration, and analysis of data from the knowledge graph. You will develop semantic queries and endpoints that support advanced search and analytics use cases, making it easier for others to retrieve insights from linked data.
  • Validation Rules Data Quality: Implement semantic validation rules and consistency checks (e.g., using SHACL or OWL constraints) to ensure data integrity and quality within the ontology and knowledge graph. You will define and enforce data modelling conventions and business rules so that enterprise data conforms to the ontology's standards and remains interoperable across systems.
  • Integration with Enterprise Systems: Work closely with software engineers, data architects, and IT teams to integrate the ontology and knowledge graph into the organization's existing data infrastructure and workflows. This includes embedding semantic models in data pipelines, APIs, and databases, so that enterprise applications can produce and consume linked data seamlessly.
  • Collaboration Cross-Functional Support: Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. For example, partner with AI/ML teams to incorporate the knowledge graph into AI-driven solutions, and team up with business analysts or data stewards to align the semantic models with business needs. You will communicate semantic concepts to non-technical stakeholders, providing training or documentation to ensure adoption of the semantic framework across the organisation.
  • Integration with AI Agents: Work with AI agents and large language model (LLM) teams to leverage the ontology and knowledge graph for intelligent applications. For instance, you might enable an AI chatbot to use the knowledge graph for more context-aware responses, or develop mechanisms for AI systems to perform reasoning over the ontologies. This responsibility ensures that semantic data structures enhance AI initiatives (e.g. improving context, disambiguation, and knowledge retrieval in AI workflows).
  • Standards Best Practices: Stay current with emerging semantic web standards, tools, and best practices. Continuously improve the semantic architecture by adopting relevant metadata standards and ensuring alignment with industry best practices for ontologies and knowledge graphs. You will also contribute to establishing internal guidelines and best practices for semantic data management, promoting a culture of well-structured, semantically-rich data across the enterprise.

jobDescription:
Make an impact with NTT DATA
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion its a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Your day at NTT DATA The Networking Managed Services Engineer (L1) is an entry level engineering role, responsible for providing a managed service to clients to ensure that their IT infrastructure and systems remain operational through proactively identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems and restoring service to clients by managing incidents to resolution.

This role has the primary objective is to ensure zero missed service level agreement (SLA) conditions and focuses on first-line support for standard and low complexity incidents and service requests.

This role may also contribute to support on project work as and when required.

What you'll be doing

Key Responsibilities:
  • Monitors client infrastructure and solutions.
  • Identifies problems and errors prior to or when they occur.
  • Routinely identifies common incidents and opportunities for avoidance as well as general opportunities for incident reduction.
  • Investigates first line incidents assigned and identifies the root cause of incidents and problems.
  • Fulfils approved requests following agreed procedures.
  • Provides telephonic or chat support to clients when required.
  • Executes approved maintenance activities including patching and configuration changes.
  • Follows the required handover procedures for shift changes to ensure service continuity.
  • Reports and escalates incidents where necessary.
  • Ensures the efficient and comprehensive resolutions of incidents and requests.
  • Proactively identifies opportunities for work optimization.
  • Updates existing knowledge articles or creates new ones.
  • Identifies opportunities for work optimization including opportunities for automation of work, request fulfilment, incident resolution, and other general process improvement opportunities.
  • May also contribute to support on project work as and when required.
  • May work on implementing and delivering Disaster Recovery functions and tests.
  • Performs any other related task as required.

Knowledge and Attributes:
  • Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
  • Ability to plan activities and projects well in advance, and takes into account possible changing circumstances.
  • Ability to maintain a positive outlook at work.
  • Ability to work well in a pressurized environment.
  • Ability to work hard and put in longer hours when it is necessary.
  • Ability to apply active listening techniques such as paraphrasing the message to confirm understanding, probing for further relevant information, and refraining from interrupting.
  • Ability to adapt to changing circumstances.
  • Ability to place clients at the forefront of all interactions, understanding their requirements, and creating a positive client experience throughout the total client journey.
  • Additional skills proficiency such as (but not limited to):
    • Pulse Secure SSL VPN Virtual Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet Firewalls Cisco Nexus switches, ASR and ISR routers Cisco ACS, ISE Meraki switches and access points Enterprise network architecture Common routing protocols: BGP,OSPF, EIGRP Network address translation Configuring, monitoring and troubleshooting uplinks to ISPs for DIA, MPLS and P2P circuits Familiarity with common network management and monitoring tools such as SecureCRT, Logic Monitor.

Academic Qualifications and Certifications:
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Information Technology/Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience).
  • CCNA or equivalent certification.
  • Certifications relevant to the services provided (certifications carry additional weightage on a candidates qualification for the role).

Required Experience:
  • Entry-level experience or completion of the relevant intern program.
  • Entry-level experience with troubleshooting and providing the support required in network data center systems storage administration and monitoring Services within a medium to large ICT organization.
  • Basic knowledge of management agents, redundancy concepts, and products within the supported technical domain (i.e. Network, Data Centre, Telephony, Exchange, Storage, Cloud, Backup, etc.).

Workplace type: On-site Working

title: Security Services Engineer (L2)
jobDescription:
Job Summary
The Security Service Engineer (L2) is a developing engineering role, operating in region, and is responsible for providing a professional technical support service to clients by identifying and resolving technical incidents and problems.
Through pre-emptive service incident and resolution activities, this role will restore service to clients by driving incidents to an effective resolution and ensuring all requests, process events and resolution incidents result in zero missed service level agreement (SLA) conditions.
Key responsibilities
  • Maintains the support process and ensures that requests for support are handled according to the procedures.
  • Uses service assurance software and tools to investigate and diagnose problems, collects performance statistics and creates reports, working with users, other staff and suppliers as appropriate.
  • Identifies and resolves problems following agreed procedures.
  • Carries out agreed maintenance tasks.
  • Ensures usage of knowledge articles in incident diagnosis and resolution and assist with updating as and when required.
  • Performs defined tasks to monitor service delivery against service level agreements and maintains records of relevant information.
  • Analyses service records against agreed service levels regularly to identify actions required to maintain or improve levels of service, and initiates or reports these actions.
  • Prioritises and diagnoses incidents according to agreed procedures.
  • Investigates causes of incidents and seeks resolution.
  • Escalates unresolved incidents and follows up until incident is resolved.
  • Provides service recovery, following resolution of incidents.
  • Documents and closes resolved incidents according to agreed procedures.
  • Maintains secure, accurate, complete, and current configuration on configuration items (CIs).
  • Applies tools, techniques and processes to track, log and correct information related to CIs, ensuring protection of assets and components from unauthorized change, diversion, and inappropriate use.
  • Remotely investigates and identifies root cause of incidents and assist with the implementation of agreed remedies and preventative measures.
  • Maintains knowledge of specific specialisms, provides detailed advice regarding their application.
  • Ensures efficient and comprehensive resolution of incidents, including ensuring that repairs are carried out by coordinating product requests, working with other team members.
  • Provides continuous feedback to clients and affected parties and update all systems, portals and ticketing tools as prescribed by standard operating procedures.
  • Identifies problems and errors prior to or when they occur.
  • Logs all such incidents in a timely manner with the required level of detail with all the necessary.
  • Cooperates with all stakeholders including client IT environments, vendors, carriers and colleagues to expedite diagnosis of errors and problems and to identify a resolution.
To thrive in this role, you need to have
  • Developing knowledge of technical documentation.
  • Developing knowledge on management agent concepts, redundancy concepts and remote console architecture within supported technical domain.
  • Developing knowledge of vendor technologies, such as Cisco, Microsoft, ARC, Audio Codes, PeterConnect , Sonus.
  • Customer service orientated and pro-active thinking.
  • Problem solver who is highly driven and self-organized.
  • Good attention to detail.
  • Good analytical and logical thinking.
  • Excellent spoken and written communication skills.
  • Team player with the ability to work well with others and in group with colleagues and stakeholders.
Academic qualifications and certifications
  • Degree or relevant qualification in Information Technology or Computing or a related field.
  • Professional level Certification in different Security Technologies such as Cisco, Juniper, Checkpoint, PaloAlto, Fortinet, Aruba, BlueCoat, ZScaler 5 such as (but not limited to) CCNP, JNCIP, ACCP, PCNSP, CCSP etc.
Required experience
  • Experience with Anti-DDoS solutions like Netscout, Arbor or Radware.
  • Moderate level experience in Security technologies such as Firewall, IPS, IDS, Proxy etc.
  • Moderate level experience in technical support to clients.
  • Moderate level experience in diagnosis and troubleshooting.
  • Moderate level experience providing remote support in Security technologies.
  • Moderate level experience in relevant technology.
Workplace type
On-site Working
